commands_run: git diff HEAD~1 -- crates/athena-data crates/athena-core/src/store.rs crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs
git diff HEAD~1 -- crates/athena-cli/src crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs crates/athena-core/src/status.rs CHANGELOG.md README.md

cargo test -p athena-core --lib -- a_low_priority_item_alone_is_still_planned holds_load_in_order_of_n a_hold_counts_for_every_state a_hold_in_the_records_worktree_is_loaded_by_load_current rejected 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain -- on_hold hold_and_release a_low_priority_item_alone_is_still_dispatched 2>&1
cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain -- on_hold hold_and_release a_low_priority_item_alone_is_still_dispatched 2>&1
cargo test --release -p athena-cli --test drain -- on_hold hold_and_release a_low_priority_item_alone_is_still_dispatched 2>&1
git diff HEAD~1 --stat -- athena.toml defaults.toml .github docs && git diff HEAD~1 -U0 -- crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs --stat

policy_denials.detail: grep -n "focus\|hold" docs/records.md | head -20; git diff HEAD~1 --stat -- docs
